name: pnp-sharepoint-skills-team-newsletter-publisher
title: Team Newsletter Publisher
shortDescription: Converts a filled Team Newsletter Word file into a designed newsletter as a PDF and/or a self-contained HTML page using a fixed layout.
longDescription: Reads a .docx created from the Team Newsletter Word template and maps every field — masthead, featured story with hero image, latest news, upcoming events, team spotlight, quick tips and contribution call — into a bundled HTML design master.

Text is copied exactly from the Word file and never invented. Empty slots are removed, sections are renumbered, and the output is saved as a self-contained HTML page and/or an A4 PDF next to the source file.
